patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width dark backgrounds with light text and lighter backgrounds with dark text, creating distinct visual breaks and guiding the user through content blocks.
Prominent display serif headings are used for aspirational section titles, set in all caps with generous letter spacing, contrasting with a clean sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
A rich, deep reddish-brown (#521010) serves as the primary background, paired with off-white text and vibrant orange-red accents for emphasis, creating a luxurious and bold aesthetic.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they scroll into the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging reading experience.
Image grid sections are used to visually represent themes, featuring a collage of diverse images under large, evocative headings, breaking up text-heavy content.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered animations are implemented using GSAP and Locomotive Scroll to reveal content sections with a subtle fade-in and upward translation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement.
Full-bleed background images and solid color fills are used for distinct section backdrops, with text overlaid using high contrast for readability.
Large, thin display serif typography is used for aspirational headings, paired with a clean sans-serif for body text, creating a sophisticated and editorial feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, thin display serif headings (~4-5x body) with generous letter spacing, complemented by a legible sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with significant vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around content blocks, especially in the hero and aspirational sections.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, rich reddish-brown background paired with elegant, oversized display serif typography creates an immediate sense of luxury and exclusivity. The scroll-triggered reveals and the dramatic, almost theatrical presentation of content set it apart from typical modern marketing sites, evoking a high-end editorial experience.
